phase: 7 -- the official destination-marketing rosters, measured before being trusted
the_bureau_was_measured: Visit Austin is a Simpleview install; its own public listings endpoint states each partner's full premises, and is read with an EMPTY filter (every partner) so no category filter of the bureau's is trusted, honouring its robots.txt Crawl-delay of 2 seconds. Travel Texas is Simpleview too but holds city pages, not lodging partners. No suburban bureau publishes a partner directory this client can read.
the_category_filter_is_read_not_trusted: Simpleview partners are pulled UNFILTERED and each partner's OWN categories are read, because a directory's category filter may be INERT.
a_roster_row_is_not_a_policy: Tier-3 IDENTITY and ROUTING evidence. The bureau's category PROPOSES that a partner is lodging; the property's own page decides what it is. No roster row carries a pet policy.
the_bureau_does_not_decide_membership: Admission is the property's OWN postal code against the corridor registry and nothing else.

bureaus_measured_and_not_walked.traveltexas.com: Simpleview; 480 listings, almost all CITY pages -- not a lodging roster
bureaus_measured_and_not_walked.chooseroundrock.com / roundrockcvb.com: no answer to this client (connection reset, three attempts)
bureaus_measured_and_not_walked.roundrocktexas.gov: WordPress; no partner directory in its sitemap
bureaus_measured_and_not_walked.visit.georgetown.org: Revize; /lodging/hotels.php renders its list by script -- no partner data served
bureaus_measured_and_not_walked.visitbuda.com: redirects to a Squarespace page (budaholics.com) with no partner directory
bureaus_measured_and_not_walked.cityofkyle.gov / leandertx.gov / lakeway: city CMS pages (Granicus / CivicPlus) with no partner directory
bureaus_measured_and_not_walked.visitsanmarcos.com / visitsanantonio.com: Simpleview, but refused cities' bureaus -- never walked
